items.source: Gets a new fully configured but paused RSocketServer instance. Clients should not be able to connect to the returned server until RSocketServer.start() is called (which happens when the ApplicationContext has been fully refreshed).
items.translation: 获取一个新的已完全配置但处于暂停状态的 RSocketServer 实例。客户端在调用 RSocketServer.start()（当ApplicationContext完全刷新时发生）之前，不应能够连接到返回的服务器。

items.source: Factory interface that can be used to create a reactive RSocketServer.
items.translation: 用于创建响应式RSocketServer的工厂接口。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
